summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill in async_execution/executor_submit domain with no semantic overlap to existing skills (which are in reward_function_integration and reward_computation domains). Peer candidates (Map Function Over Iterables, Future Result Retrieval, Future Exception Inspection) are complementary executor patterns at the same granularity level, not duplicates. Candidate represents the foundational submit() operation; peers represent map() and result/exception access patterns. All are semantically distinct capabilities within the concurrent.futures ecosystem.
